responsibility: Declares the central expression- and type-classification API for GIMPLE, including predicates for invariants, registers, lvalues, addresses, call operands, and compatible types, along with helpers for temporary creation, operand extraction, addressability marking, and condition canonicalization. It is the public header that exposes the middle end’s notion of what tree forms are valid in GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the public declaration and inline-wrapper header for GIMPLE expression/type predicates and helpers, exposing APIs and small inline classifiers, while the .cc file holds the substantive predicate and addressability implementations.
